note: Sound effects made with ElevenLabs by sound_takes.py. prompt: what to ask for. seconds: how long each take is. influence: how closely a take follows the prompt, from 0 to 1. takes: how many to make in a batch. file: where the chosen take goes in the game; several takes kept for one sound go beside it, numbered. loop: the sound runs seamlessly back into its start, for as long as it is held.

gunshot.prompt: A single pistol gunshot fired close by: one sharp, dry, punchy crack with a short tail. No echo, no reverb, no shell casing, no music.

gavel.prompt: A single wooden gavel struck once on a sound block in a quiet room: one sharp, solid, dry wooden knock with a short tail. No voices, no echo, no music.

menu_point.prompt: A single soft pencil tick on paper: one tiny, dry graphite tap, very short and quiet. No music, no voices.

menu_press.prompt: A single firm tap of a pen nib on a sheet of paper lying on a wooden desk: one short, crisp, dry tap. No music, no voices.

breath_out.prompt: One slow, tired breath out through the nose, very close and intimate, a man drifting off to sleep. Soft and quiet. No voice, no music.

breath_in.prompt: One slow, deep breath in through the nose, very close and intimate, a man waking up. Soft and quiet. No voice, no music.

veil_down.prompt: A single sheet of paper gently laid down flat over a desk: a soft papery swish and settle. No music, no voices.

veil_up.prompt: A single sheet of paper lifted off a desk: one quick, soft papery swish. No music, no voices.

choice_commit.prompt: A quick, confident stroke of a felt pen underlining a word on paper: one short, scratchy swipe. No music, no voices.

advance.prompt: A very soft, short tap of a fingertip on a sheet of paper: one gentle, muted tap. No music, no voices.

count_tick.prompt: A single tiny mechanical tally counter click: one crisp, very short, quiet click. No music, no voices.

imp_scribble.prompt: A fast scribble of a pen on paper ending in a small cartoon pop: quick scratchy scribbling, then one soft pop. No music, no voices.

imp_dissolve.prompt: A soft, wet fizzing hiss of ink soaking into paper, like water sinking into a sponge, fading away to silence. Gentle and quiet. No music, no voices.

button_press.prompt: A single chunky plastic push button pressed down and released: one satisfying, solid click and clack. No music, no voices.

pin_whirr.prompt: A small metal pin spinning fast in circles on a table: a steady, light, whirring rattle, even and continuous from start to end. No music, no voices.

pin_drop.prompt: A small metal pin dropping and sticking into a cork board: one short, solid thunk. No music, no voices.

boom.prompt: A distant cartoon explosion heard muffled through a wall: one deep, soft boom with a low rumble that fades out. No music, no voices.

charge_steps.prompt: Heavy footsteps of something big running straight at the listener across a wooden floor, getting closer and louder all the way: thundering, fast, building. No music, no voices.

applause.prompt: A small television studio audience bursting into enthusiastic applause and cheering, a few whoops, then dying down. No music.

murmur.prompt: A television studio audience murmuring and whispering to each other in anticipation: low, indistinct, no words heard clearly, steady and even from start to end. No music.

win_ding.prompt: A game show correct answer sound: two bright, cheerful bell dings. No music, no voices.

lose_buzzer.prompt: A game show wrong answer buzzer: one short, flat, comic electric buzz. No music, no voices.

party_popper.prompt: A single party popper going off: one sharp little pop and a rustle of paper confetti falling. No music, no voices.

gift_box.prompt: A cardboard gift box being opened: a ribbon pulled loose and a lid lifted off, a quick papery rustle. No music, no voices.

die_roll.prompt: A single wooden die thrown across a wooden table, tumbling and clattering, then settling to a stop. No music, no voices.

die_chime.prompt: One small, bright chime, like a tiny bell struck once: clear and sweet, with a short ring. No music, no voices.
